exposure: Time of day of emergency cesarean section
outcome: Decision to delivery interval for emergency cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing emergency cesarean section at Bahir Dar City Public Hospitals, Ethiopia
finding: Decision-to-delivery intervals for emergency cesarean section were not achieved within the recommended time interval (30 minutes) and were significantly associated with factors such as referral status, time of day, surgeon status, anesthesia type, and transfer time.
